organisations.name: Harbourside Family Practice
organisations.description: Private general practice in Subregion A1 with four doctors and two nurses, all registered with the Subregion A1 Health Professions Board. Patients pay the practice directly under its terms of care. The practice does not bill any insurer.

organisations.name: Northgate Cloud Inc.
organisations.description: Company incorporated in Region B that hosts electronic patient record systems for clinics in several countries, on servers in Region B. It does not use hosted records for its own purposes. It holds an active certification under the Region B Trusted Recipient Scheme.

transfer.title: Subregion A1 GP practice moves its patient record system to a Region B-hosted cloud service, keeping the decryption keys

data.description: The practice's electronic patient record: names, dates of birth, contact details, consultation notes, diagnoses, prescriptions, test results and correspondence.

transfer.purpose_description: Hosting the record the doctors and nurses use to diagnose, treat and follow up the practice's patients, replacing the practice's on-premises server.
transfer.retention: The practice's retention schedule applies. The signed service agreement says that when the service ends Northgate will return all records to the practice and keep no copy.
transfer.method: One-off migration from the old server, then daily use by the practice's staff in Subregion A1. Records are encrypted at the practice before they leave it and stay encrypted in transit and at rest in Region B. The decryption keys are generated and held only in a hardware security module at the practice's premises in Subregion A1; Northgate never receives them and cannot decrypt the records. Northgate support engineers see only encrypted records and system logs.
transfer.additional_info: The first transfer is planned for 16 November 2026.

evidence.title: Hosting and processing agreement
evidence.summary: Signed by both parties. Sets out the subject-matter, duration, nature and purpose of the hosting, the types of information and the categories of patients. Northgate acts only on the practice's documented instructions, including about where records are stored and who may access them; its staff are bound by confidentiality; it applies the security measures in the schedule; it may not engage another provider without the practice's written consent; it assists the practice and makes compliance information available for audit. The practice has chosen return: on termination Northgate returns all records to the practice and keeps no copy.

evidence.title: Approved transfer clauses
evidence.summary: The transfer clauses approved by the Commission, executed without modification by the practice as exporter and Northgate as recipient.

evidence.title: Assessment for reliance on the approved transfer clauses
evidence.summary: Prepared by the practice before signing the clauses. Records that Northgate is incorporated in Region B, stores the records there and is subject to Region B law; that the practice considered whether Region B public authorities could require Northgate to disclose or give access to the records; and that it adopted, as a supplementary measure, encryption with the decryption keys held only at the practice in Subregion A1.

evidence.title: Impact assessment of the hosting arrangement
evidence.summary: Completed by the practice before any transfer. Describes the hosting of the patient record system by Northgate in Region B, assesses why it is necessary to replace the on-premises server, assesses the risks to patients, including access to the records in Region B, and sets out the measures adopted, including encryption with keys held only at the practice.

evidence.title: Letter to the Subregion A1 Information Commission
evidence.summary: Written notice from the practice to the Subregion A1 Information Commission that it plans to transfer its patient records to Northgate Cloud Inc. for hosting in Region B, with the first transfer on 16 November 2026.

evidence.title: Region B Trusted Recipient Scheme certificate
evidence.summary: Northgate Cloud Inc. holds an active certification under the Region B Trusted Recipient Scheme, valid until 2027-12-31, covering hosting services.

evidence.title: Patient information notice
evidence.summary: Tells patients who the practice is, why it holds their records, that its legal basis is the care relationship with them, who receives records, how long they are kept and their rights. It says records will be hosted by Northgate Cloud Inc. in Region B under approved transfer clauses.
